zh.summary: 插件直连命令和便携版设置反馈更可靠。
highlights: 当 pnpm 仅因 profile 中已有插件仍处于发布时间安全等待期而拒绝 add、update 或 remove 时，Portable 会只为当前命令精确重试一次。
默认供应链等待策略保持开启；其他安装错误不会自动重试，也不会修改全局或 profile 配置。
通用设置按更新、桌面行为、检查与修复、数据迁移重新分组；检查更新和维护结果会显示在对应操作旁。
本次包含 Portable 运行层更新；从旧版本升级时会使用完整包并保留 data 中的用户数据。

en.summary: Direct plugin commands and Portable settings feedback are more reliable.
highlights: When pnpm rejects add, update, or remove solely because an existing profile dependency is still inside the release-age safety window, Portable retries that command once.
The default supply-chain wait remains enabled. Other installation errors are not retried, and no global or profile setting is changed.
General settings now group updates, desktop behavior, maintenance, and data migration. Update and maintenance results stay beside the action that produced them.
This release updates the Portable runtime layer. Upgrades from older versions use the complete package while preserving user data in data.
